expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol with request correlation through a `request_id`, message creation timing via a `timestamp`, and optional extensibility through `metadata`, while preserving the existing Ping behavior and keeping the encode/decode flow straightforward.

Shipped v2 Hello support with the explicit `v:2` envelope format.
